svg.text: BEST FOR: LLM INFERENCE LOAD BALANCING & KV ROUTING
FORMAT LINEAGE: Kavi Priyan (#01, 607 likes) • Sahn Lam • SGLang RadixAttention / vLLM
Load Balancing for LLM Inference: Why Round-Robin Fails and How Prefix-Aware KV Routing Fixes It
LLM requests are stateful and asymmetric: a 32K prefill saturates compute while a 200-token decode starves on HBM bandwidth.
01 • WHY NAIVE ROUND-ROBIN BREAKS FOR LLM INFERENCE
Traditional HTTP load balancers treat every request as equal and stateless. In multi-turn agent
loops, Turn 12 shares 92% of its prompt prefix with Turns 1-11. Round-robin scatters Turn 12 to
a cold GPU worker, forcing it to recompute 28,000 prefill tokens from scratch while stalling
LIVE REQUEST ROUTING: RADIX PREFIX TREE + LEAST-KV-PRESSURE LOAD BALANCER
ITL: 11.2 ms • Serves REQ #402 with 8K cached KV blocks
TTFT: 185 ms (-78%) • Reuses 24K KV tokens for REQ #401
Saturated HBM + long prefill running -> router diverts new traffic
76% free HBM -> absorbs cold 14K prefill (REQ #403) cleanly
ZOOM A • CHUNKED PREFILL STOPS DECODE STALLS
Without chunking (32K prefill blocks decode for 850 ms):
With chunked prefill (2K chunks interleaved with active decode):
Splitting long prompts into 2,048-token prefill chunks lets decode
tokens piggyback on every iteration — keeping P95 ITL under 15 ms.
ZOOM B • DISAGGREGATED PREFILL & DECODE POOLS
Separating Prefill GPUs from Decode GPUs (DistServe / Mooncake /
vLLM Disaggregated) stops compute-heavy prompts from starving token
Route based on live GPU HBM KV-cache block utilization and
waiting prefill tokens — never by raw active HTTP connection
GKE Inference Gateway ⇄ Envoy + vLLM metrics
Maintain a distributed Radix tree of prompt prefixes across
workers; route multi-turn agent calls to the GPU holding their
Cap prefill batch chunks to 2K tokens on mixed pools, or
disaggregate Prefill and Decode onto dedicated GPU pools
Strict dual SLOs: TTFT < 250ms and ITL < 15ms
Rule: Route LLM traffic by (Prefix Overlap − HBM KV Pressure − Queued Prefill Tokens), never by round-robin request count.
